subject.title: feat(cron): default agent turns to the current conversation, add /loop, tighten cron tool surface

question: Should omitted `sessionTarget` for session-keyed gateway `agentTurn` jobs become conversation-bound rather than isolated by default?
rationale: This intentionally changes the runtime behavior of existing callers and needs maintainer product and compatibility judgment, not only test confirmation.

options.title: Preserve isolated default
options.body: Keep detached execution as the implicit behavior and require `/loop` or callers to select conversation binding explicitly.

options.title: Adopt current-session default
options.body: Accept conversation-bound follow-up behavior and retain explicit documentation and upgrade-focused coverage for session-keyed callers.

recommendation.title: Adopt current-session default
recommendation.body: Accept conversation-bound follow-up behavior and retain explicit documentation and upgrade-focused coverage for session-keyed callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR rationale and commits connect this contributor directly to the proposed behavior, although independent current-main ownership could not be traced.
